digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action / bridge-state configuration
propositions: Reconcile Bridge scheduled run fails with 'project = LEG AND status != Done' JQL parse error because the live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO that do not exist in live Jira

The multi-project fan-out in fetcher._build_snapshot iterates over all keys in projects.json and issues per-project JQL queries, causing the first nonexistent key (LEG) to trigger ACLI exit 1 and abort the entire pass

The projects.json corruption was introduced by ad-hoc git commits on the live tickets branch using test-fixture identity, violating the required practice of unified store writes under write_lock with auto-commit and auto-publish
Restoring projects.json to the canonical single-project state {version: 1, legacy_default: REB, projects: {}} resolves the outage by falling back to the configured REB project query
